# Portfolio 2: Performance analysis (generated by run_portfolio2.py)

Dataset: 40,000 registrations, 2,000 students. Median of 30 runs, SQLite 3.53.4.

| Experiment | Before (ms) | After (ms) | Speed-up |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| O1 class list for one offering | 0.994 | 0.279 | 3.6x |
| O2 active students in a programme/intake | 0.228 | 0.088 | 2.6x |
| O3 failing results (score < 40) | 3.130 | 0.321 | 9.7x |
| O4 results for one semester via offering | 0.482 | 0.484 | 1.0x |

Query rewrite (correlated subquery vs LEFT JOIN + GROUP BY): 0.58 ms vs 1.62 ms; identical results: True.
